card.name: First letter of a drug name
card.fires_on: The single opening letter (g, n, N, C, f) of a drug name that is split into pieces, right where a drug is first named in a list or sentence. Examples: gatifloxacin, naloxone, nalmefene, cisatracurium, folic acid.

modes.label: Start of a split drug name
modes.description: A lone first letter begins a drug name that continues in the next piece, such as after a comma in a list of agents.
